Audited all 89 verses against the Urdu body. Removed the stray “Lyrics in Urdu text” footer, corrected Roman spelling and phonetics, and changed “bhai mera” to “bhai tera” to match بھائی تیرا. The Roman and source now each have 89 verse lines. The Urdu body and metadata were preserved.

The readings corresponding to غاذزی, یی, ڈر, and شما still need human editorial sign-off. The Roman retains the existing readings for those words.
